structured_summary: The robot announces a package delivery; the recipient must acknowledge the delivery within 8 seconds of the announcement, after which the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second of receiving the acknowledgment.

obligations.source_sentence: The recipient should acknowledge the delivery within 8 seconds.
Once acknowledged, the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second.

missing_details: What constitutes an acknowledgment (e.g., speech, button press, gesture)?
What constitutes a confirmation (e.g., speech, display, LED)?
Failure handling if the recipient does not acknowledge within 8 seconds.
Failure handling if the robot does not confirm within 1 second.
Whether the timing windows start at the beginning or end of the announcement/acknowledgment.
potential_ambiguities: The start time for the 8‑second acknowledgment window is not specified (does it begin at the start or end of the announcement?).
The modality of acknowledgment and confirmation is unspecified (verbal, gestural, button).
The terms 'acknowledge' and 'confirm' may be interpreted differently across participants.
